title: Deleting a WordPress or Joomla record that lives in several languages is one door question and one call: content.delete with no locale names the record's N languages in its question, the yes authorises exactly that group, and one call deletes each member through the plugin's per-item delete under one apply_id; locale keeps a delete to one language
steps: S1: No stand, no browser, no model. Work in the TCH checkout at the commit under test, with its dependencies installed (pnpm install) and the deepseek-harness submodule initialised.
S2: From the checkout root run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/delete-group.test.mjs — keep the 'ok'/'not ok' lines and the exit code.
expect: S2: every test named in run.tests reports ok. On a fake WordPress site (a post in 3 languages, Polylang group read from content.read) and a fake Joomla site (an article in 2 languages, associations): content.delete {kind, id} with no locale is refused CONFIRM_FIRST with languages:N and a question naming the title 'in all N languages', nothing deleted; after the customer's yes to that question one call sends one content.delete per member (the named one first) under one apply_id and answers deleted [{id, locale}] plus one undo; a member that fails is listed in failed with its code while the others go; the named record refused stops the rest; a lost answer stops the walk and lists the rest NOT_SENT; locale keeps the delete to one record and its answer names what stays online; a locale that is not the record's is refused LOCALE_NOT_THIS_RECORD with the right call; the yes never opens another record or a second call; a one-language site, a record not listed, or an unreadable listing leaves the plain one-record question.

selectors.wiring: site-call.mjs runSiteCall destructive tier (group key, CONFIRM_FIRST text) + deleteGroup; normalize.mjs HOST_PARAMS content.delete locale; tiers.mjs tiersSentenceFor

evidence: Local stand 09/10/2026, benchwp02 (news post in 41 languages), request 'Xoá bài tin "Four common mistakes in heavy machine foundation design" khỏi website': one run made 82 refused content.delete calls (CONFIRM_FIRST), 4 questions to the customer, 109 tool calls, 1.3M prompt tokens, 274 s, and left 39 translations live (~/tracy-bench-work/bench/out-v7-abl-hb-after3-noorder-r1-r1/benchwp02/V7-delete-chat-dev); other runs deleted with wp post delete in bash. benchjoomla02 showed the same loop at 12-17 calls.
fence: Mechanism only: the group read, the question's scope, the confirmation key, the one-call loop and its receipt. Not covered: whether a model then makes one call (a bench measure), and the plugin's own trash and undo (unchanged).
